newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Jewish settlers reported attacking Arab workers.
newsitem.headline: Jewish settlers reported attacking Arab workers.

text.p: Jewish settlers attacked Palestinian labourers and broke windshields of Arab-owned cars late on Monday in the West Bank town of Hebron, Palestinian officials said.
They said the labourers were working on a Palestinian family's house next to a Jewish seminary when the settlers attacked them.
One of the labourers was taken to hospital complaining of abdominal pain. His condition was not immediately known.
The Israeli army said it was checking the report.
Hebron, a flashpoint of Arab-Israeli violence, is the only West Bank town with a Jewish population. Some 400 Jews live in the heart of the town of 100,000 Arabs.
Israel was to have withdrawn its troops from most of Hebron earlier this year but froze the pullout in response to a wave of Islamic suicide bombings in the Jewish state.
The withdrawal has been further delayed by peace talks dedlocked over Israel's demand that its forces be allowed to pursue suspected guerrillas into self-ruled areas.
